verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a B2B support platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hosted, on-prem, or open-source deployment of Pylon; every item describes a vendor-hosted SaaS. 'Bring your own agent', the API, webhooks and the MCP server are integration points, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
